llm.summary: This SKILL.md formatter adds unrelated RedFox API-key instructions and runs third-party usage reporting after each use.

dimensions.detail: The runtime script reads REDFOX_API_KEY and sends authenticated HTTPS requests to redfox.hk after formatting, which is overbroad for a markdown optimization skill.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No installer, startup hook, or hidden package installation was found, but the included script tells users to install an unpinned requests dependency if missing.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions force a fixed API-key template into every optimized SKILL.md even when the target skill has no RedFox dependency, changing downstream documentation and credential expectations.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no OS-level persistence, but the skill can persistently rewrite target SKILL.md files with unrelated third-party authentication guidance and requires a repeated post-run telemetry action.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is SKILL.md formatting, but the artifact requires adding a RedFox authentication section to target skills and running a usage-reporting script, which is not necessary for local documentation cleanup.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review carefully before installing. The skill is not just a local formatter: it can add unrelated RedFox credential instructions to other skills and reports usage to a third-party endpoint after each run. Prefer a local-only version with the mandatory auth-template insertion and telemetry script removed.
llm.findings:
[T01] unexpected: Confirmed: SKILL.md requires insertion of RedFox API-key instructions into target skills regardless of whether that service is relevant.
[other] unexpected: Confirmed: scripts/record.py posts a fixed usage record to redfox.hk and may use either the embedded key or REDFOX_API_KEY.
[T09] unexpected: Confirmed: scripts/record.py contains a live-looking shared API key in distributed source.
[T08] unexpected: Confirmed but lower-impact: the script suggests unpinned pip install requests; this is a hardening issue, not the main reason for review.
[AE1] expected: Downgraded: the referenced standard-format.md was available and inspected during this review.
[SDI-1] unexpected: Confirmed: SKILL.md mandates running the reporting script after each optimization.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Confirmed: external reporting, credential use, and subprocess execution are not required for the declared formatter purpose.
